bathAction.title: Stand
bathAction.tooltip: Stand under the water. Half a minute. Hair, chest, and arms are easy from here.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(stand)] under the water and [npc.verb(let)] it run over [npc.her] shoulders and down [npc.her] chest. [npc.Her] hands are free for the parts up high. [npc.speech(Up, then. I can reach the rest from here.)]
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(step)] under the spray and [npc.verb(tilt)] [npc.her] head back into it, letting it pound [npc.her] face and [npc.her] chest. [npc.speech(Yes. Right here. Keep it on me.)]
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(plant)] [npc.herself] under the water, feet set, and [npc.verb(get)] on with the parts [npc.she] can reach without bending. [npc.speech(Stay standing. Get on with it.)]
